headline: A pilot stabs another pilot and tries to crash their flight to Tel Aviv, Israel says
context: As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.
